title: Aurilia under a thousand-year winter
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: an establishing shot of the land of Aurilia locked in an endless winter at dusk. A vast frozen continent of snowbound forests, iced-over rivers and black mountains, seen from high above. Far off rises a capital of pale ice-blue towers and high walls. Tiny lantern-lit patrols of armoured Frost Wardens move along a snowy road below. Deep beneath the cracked ice of a frozen lake in the foreground, a faint ember-orange glow pulses, as if an old fire is waking under the frost. Cold, quiet, oppressive, with that one warm glow as the focal point.

references.role: Geography reference only: the campaign map of Aurilia. Use it for the feel of the land (coast, mountains, forests, rivers), not as a map; do not reproduce labels or the map style.

alt: Aurilia frozen under endless winter at dusk, an ice-blue capital in the distance and an ember glow waking beneath a frozen lake.
